question: What nourishing and maternal splendor defines the goddess as world-mother?
premises: The goddess is a stream of milk and of excellent nature.
She is the mother of the world.
inference: The goddess nourishes as a stream of milk and shines as the splendid mother of the world.
plain_english: She is a stream of milk, of excellent nature, the mother of the world, and of great splendor.
